Here it is—no tables, no fluff, just the exact dates and workouts to screenshot or paste into your notes:
WEEK 1 (Acclimation – keep 2–3 reps in the tank)
Wed, Nov 18 – Lower & Rotation
 * Med Ball Rotational Toss: 4x5 each side
 * Trap Bar Deadlift (or Squat): 4x5
 * Bulgarian Split Squat: 3x6 each leg
 * Broad Jumps: 3x4
 * Pallof Press: 3x10 each side
Fri, Nov 20 – Upper, Speed & Neck
 * Plyo Push-Ups (or Med Ball Chest Pass): 4x5
 * Weighted Pull-Ups: 4x5
 * Landmine Single-Arm Press: 3x6 each side
 * Chest-Supported DB Row: 3x8
 * 4-Way Neck Iso/Harness: 2x15s each way
 * Hanging Leg Raises: 3x10
Mon, Nov 23 – Conditioning (4 Rounds)
 * 10s max sprint + 50s easy pace (repeat 3x = 1 round). Rest 1 min between rounds. Do 4 rounds.
WEEK 2 (Add Weight)
Wed, Nov 25 – Lower & Rotation
 * Same workout as Nov 18, add 2.5–5 kg to Deadlift & Split Squats.
Fri, Nov 27 – Upper, Speed & Neck
 * Same workout as Nov 20, add 2.5–5 kg to Pull-Ups & Landmine Press.
Mon, Nov 30 – Conditioning (5 Rounds)
 * Same 3-min round intervals. Do 5 rounds.
WEEK 3 (Peak Intensity)
Wed, Dec 2 – Lower & Rotation
 * Same workout, heaviest weights on lifts, max speed on throws/jumps.
Fri, Dec 4 – Upper, Speed & Neck
 * Same workout, heaviest weights on lifts, max speed on plyos.
Mon, Dec 7 – Conditioning (6 Rounds)
 * Same 3-min round intervals. Do 6 rounds.
WEEK 4 (Deload / Taper)
Wed, Dec 9 – Lower & Rotation
 * Same exercises, cut 1 set off everything and drop weights by 15%.
Fri, Dec 11 – Upper, Speed & Neck
 * Same exercises, cut 1 set off everything and drop weights by 15%.
Mon, Dec 14 – Conditioning (3 Rounds)
 * Same 3-min round intervals. Do 3 sharp rounds.
